title: File Copy Tool — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Copies files and directories between locations with verification. The File Copy Tool duplicates files and whole directory trees from a source to a destination. It preserves file metadata where the platform allows, copies recursively on request, and verifies each copied file with a checksum comparison against the original. Failed or partial copies are reported per file, never silently skipped.
capabilities: Copy single files with checksum verification
Recursive directory-tree copying
Preserve timestamps and permissions where supported
Skip-or-overwrite policies for existing destinations
Per-file success/failure report for batch copies
